ITEM 1 | Large fan of cooked tubular pasta (penne-like) with smooth, glossy pale-yellow surface, lightly oiled, pieces about 4-5 cm long and 1 cm wide, spread across the lower right and center of the plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Wilted dark green leafy greens (spinach-like) with glossy, slightly limp leaves, bright green with darker veins, clustered at the upper center of the plate, about 7 cm across | 45
ITEM 3 | Pale golden cubes of starchy vegetable (potato-like) with browned edges and slightly crisp surfaces, about 2 cm pieces, located at the top center near the greens | 35
ITEM 4 | Pinkish-brown sliced meat with moist, slightly glossy surface and fine fibrous grain, pieces about 5 x 3 cm, sitting at the right center beside the pasta | 40
ITEM 5 | Creamy white sauce with pale ivory color and thick, slightly glossy texture, coating and pooling over the center-left portion, with small green flecks mixed in | 30
ITEM 6 | Crumbly brown granular topping (breadcrumb or crumb-like) with dry, rough texture and toasted golden-brown flecks, scattered over the right side and bottom of the plate | 20
ITEM 7 | Small dark brown mushroom-like pieces with matte, slightly moist surface, about 1-2 cm, few pieces at the upper left edge of the plate near the sauce | 8
ITEM 8 | Scattered small green herb flecks, bright green and finely chopped, mixed into the sauce and greens across the center | 3
